name: Caterpie (CobbleEffort form)
look: purple with a pink forked feeler, a cream belly and a curled yellow tail tip
entry: Its purple body warns every bird Pokémon away: it is laced with poison from the toxic leaves it eats. When something comes too close it rears up and flicks out its pink, forked feeler, which oozes a stinging, foul-smelling liquid.
how: Wild: common in jungles, swamps, flower forests and dark forests.
Evolves into the CobbleEffort Metapod at level 7.
